scene_play.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished Chinese game CONCEPT screenshot, new scene-integrated 九点 minigame UI.
Reference image 1 is the authoritative existing prison game WORLD and HUD style. Reference image 2 is ONLY the four seated character identities and orange uniform/table material reference; do NOT reproduce its fullscreen card-game composition.
Create ONE cohesive widescreen 16:9 screenshot, 1600x900 appearance. Same orthographic near-top-down 2D painted sprite art, muted gray-green tiles, thick fine dark sprite outlines, tiny chibi orange-uniform inmates, cream riveted HUD panels and restrained teal accents. No isometric perspective, no realistic humans, no neon casino, no enormous alternate card table backdrop.
Critical composition: gameplay world remains fully visible and undimmed over at least 70% of screen. The player stays seated at the EXISTING physical square green-felt card table INSIDE the 棋牌活动室, with three different seated inmates (Zhou short cropped hair, Xu black glasses, Lu elderly gray hair). Table and actors are ordinary map-scale fixtures, not a fullscreen UI. Show surrounding room walls, wood cabinet, tea corner, nearby Chinese chess table and bench; adjacent reading-room roof on left, infirmary on right, corridor and open doorway below. A teal-uniform patrolling guard is visibly walking in corridor outside with a small natural overhead label. There is no blackout, no blur, no screen-filling modal, and no second duplicated table inside any UI panel.
Retain the existing TOP-left health/hunger portrait HUD and TOP-center wide time/day timeline HUD. TOP-center text “09:12” “自由活动” and “第1天”; top-right game money “90” and pause icon. Add a small cream event toast BELOW the top HUD, at upper-left: “广播：5分钟后集合”. It must leave room and corridor visible; time passing and external events visibly remain part of the experience.
A tiny cream tag floating ABOVE the actual world card table says “九点 · 第1局”; tiny amber coin pile in middle of map table, tiny card backs near NPC seats and small revealed card near player's seat. Characters correctly seated, chair backrests behind or in front of bodies as physically appropriate.
Put ONE compact tactile cream-and-teal play control panel in LOWER-RIGHT, about 390px wide and 280px high, covering only around 10% of screen. Exact heading “你的手牌”. Two modest portrait card slots side-by-side: first card clean 7♣ with rank in two corners and ONE large central club emblem; second empty dashed slot. Under cards “当前 7 点”. Above cards a small strip “4人牌局    奖池 40” (no oversized central pot panel). Bottom two horizontally aligned buttons: teal “摸第二张 E” and cream “停牌 空格”. Tiny footer link “离桌 Esc” and small “规则”. Four participants represented by tiny names and concise stakes above actual scene seats, not big separate player portraits. Do NOT place buttons on left side. All text crisp Chinese and legible. No bonus panels, no giant title, no annotations outside screenshot. The overall impression is the existing prison simulator still running while a small local tabletop interaction is open.

scene_scratch.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied new scene-integrated prison 九点 concept screenshot.
Preserve EXACT existing map, overhead camera, 4 seated inmates around the small actual room table, room and neighboring buildings, undimmed gameplay visibility, top HUD, Chinese cream-rivet/teal UI style. Preserve the compact lower-right panel footprint, no fullscreen modal, no dark overlay, no blur, no giant duplicate card table.
Change only to SECOND-CARD SCRATCH REVEAL state. The right-bottom hand panel heading becomes “擦开第二张”. Keep small strip “4人牌局    奖池 40”. Inside panel, left is small revealed first card 7♣ (rank corners and one central club emblem), right is a larger portrait SECOND CARD approx 150x180 pixels with blue-gray patterned opaque card-back cover. About one-third of that cover has been rubbed away along an irregular diagonal trail with ragged brushed edges. The uncovered area shows the white face of the exact same single card underneath and a hint of RED diamond suit; all rank numerals remain covered. The white revealed patch MUST be contained inside the card silhouette. Add a small cursor/hand rubbing one point on the boundary of this scratch trail, no real giant physical human hand. Show clearly recognizable scratch-off gesture and remaining covered card. Do not print or disclose the second card point value, sum, winners or payouts anywhere. Under card exact text “点数待揭晓”. A short line “按住拖动，慢慢擦开”. Bottom modest teal button “直接翻开”, keep small cream link “离桌 Esc” and “规则”. Remove “摸第二张”, “停牌”, and “当前7点” while scratching, no impossible next-step buttons.
Make the TOP world clock advance from 09:12 to “09:13”, broadcast toast text “广播：4分钟后集合”; move the same patrol guard slightly farther along the outdoor corridor, so external world clearly continues while rubbing the card. Preserve all other art, composition, lighting, seated character positions, map table card backs and world HUD. This is a concept screenshot of an embedded mini activity, not a standalone casino screen. Crisp readable Chinese text.
